customer_message: My product arrived damaged and I want a refund.
notes: Delivered 2017-10-10, EDD 2017-10-18. Delivered on time. Damage report is hypothetical – tests RET-09/RET-10 window logic relative to current date.

customer_message: I want to return this item. It is not what I needed.
notes: Delivered 2018-08-07. Tests standard 30-day return window (RET-02/RET-03). Window long expired – expect denial.

customer_message: I received the wrong item. This is not what I ordered. I want a replacement.
notes: Delivered 2018-08-17. Tests incorrect item path (RET-11). Report window of 14 days expired – expect denial.

customer_message: My order is three days late and I have not received it yet.
notes: EDD 2017-12-15. Tests DEL-07 minor delay path (1-3 days). Since data is historical the delay calc uses today vs EDD – will show significant delay.

customer_message: My package still has not arrived. It is way past the estimated delivery date.
notes: EDD 2018-02-26, delivered 2018-02-16. Actually delivered early. Tests delivery status inspection.

customer_message: The tracking says my package was delivered but I did not receive anything. I have checked everywhere.
notes: Delivered 2017-02-02. Tests DEL-12 marked-delivered-but-missing path. Report is outside 7-day window → expects escalation.

customer_message: My order has been in shipped status for weeks and is not moving.
notes: Status: shipped. Tests DEL-11 stuck-in-transit logic.

customer_message: I was charged twice for my order. I can see two payments on my bank statement.
notes: This order has 2 payment records. Tests PAY-06 duplicate charge detection.

customer_message: What is the status of my payment? I am not sure if it went through.
notes: Order has multiple payment records. Tests PAY-03 payment status check.

customer_message: I cancelled my order but I have not received my refund yet.
notes: Order status: canceled. Tests PAY-08 / REF-08 cancelled order refund path.

customer_message: My headphones arrived completely smashed. The box looked like it was dropped from a great height. I want a full refund immediately.
notes: Order value ~$810. Tests RET-17 escalation threshold (>$500). Expects escalation to human.

customer_message: There was a missing item in my delivery. The box was sealed but one of the products was not inside.
notes: Delivered 2017-05-26. Tests RET-12 missing item path. Date is historical so 14-day window has expired.

customer_message: I am not happy with my purchase and would like to return it.
notes: Ambiguous message. No specific damage/incorrect signal. Tests keyword detection default to standard return.

customer_message: I need to speak to someone about a billing problem on my account. Something does not look right.
notes: Vague payment complaint. Tests whether routing correctly identifies payment route from limited signal.

customer_message: I want a refund for my order.
notes: Deliberately invalid order ID. Tests graceful error handling – expects escalate=true with data error.
